data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=B6cFmk8IKcwQ7kNvgHK03OQ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA8bkFBTHz0BD-sReV5VlcMOPFDkYf52LU2TQwEaMY8aA&oe=674D9A9C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=M7MSp1XsLFIQ7kNvgH_mvS_&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD3M5IH32PcKRauIsCUind15kxEEZp5nq9fIU1nQHyNrA&oe=674DA424)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ql0fa2Didq8Q7kNvgHz3ObD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCr0pSdk2w-iU_s3gQBz39Smr1VNRkhvTxrMjaWi4_4LQ&oe=674D8B87)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=idTuyE9fME8Q7kNvgE1doYh&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA368Y6D6KR3Wyud18MB0GnTEoh2pNfZZzy-Kb_eGwLNg&oe=674D7E66)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=D_KK3DZ1DPcQ7kNvgGAyBXE&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAcC8CGniyByruNAeCSmL6rt-Qorv5ByS0kBO4Kyv9qQQ&oe=674DAAD8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=pfTPHkPnmA4Q7kNvgEjQTzO&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBZ5P8CfqBAqB652U-ieGLKku25OGteK26ZnjjH_mI9bg&oe=674DA759)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ATyK1APDfxUQ7kNvgFcc3n7&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBBk6jyNCeK11YZmSeAxadwjN9JvBZb7kjqw6KEOeNp8Q&oe=674D8D70)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iswbpamKjeMQ7kNvgFYNdNC&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAoDmv_orMJoquMZhLxgymqN6nsx6Xu_ewFnfvPeqTV8w&oe=674DB02A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=zJOBndIary8Q7kNvgFTkEDq&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBeNnDvNkqw83A160uPdZ8I1a01FxC1oGiFw8K9pLzEIg&oe=674D8B97)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=IJYbzPue058Q7kNvgGgrzN3&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAYoroZGbnqmCmBWbe1CUO9Y0MEY7P2noGjqgMri94PJg&oe=674DA70C)
